scope: All 48 predeclared fits; original test stream never used; development decisions are validation-only; fresh audit includes every arm without selection.
limitations: This matrix excludes no-regime fits and is not a complete canonical proof panel.
Gumbel-to-ST changes RNG consumption, so later masking/dropout draws differ. Compare complete training recipes, not perfectly RNG-matched routing-only causal effects.
The ST, ST+small-init, and ST+small-init+margin1 arms share the same RNG draw protocol relative to each other.
Validation accepts proposals and compares recipes; it is tuning data. Fresh audit rows use split10003 only after all variants and validation files freeze.
No production code or default behavior changed; these are root-only numeric residual experiments.
Concurrent CPU wall times are descriptive, not the separate P081 isolated cost benchmark.
